subject: SEC: pin createdAt in firestore.rules users create (client-forgeable timestamp)
description: Found by Nancy 2026-09-08 during task 367; I verified it in the rules myself. The users/{userId} CREATE rule lists createdAt inside hasOnly() but, unlike xp / streak / tier / grandfathered which are each pinned with request.resource.data.get(field, default) == value, puts NO value constraint on createdAt. A client can set it to any Timestamp, including one backdated years, in the same setDoc that creates their profile - the raw-REST-with-own-idToken technique already proven against this exact document in BUG-262/263. NOT load-bearing for 367 any more: that fix was re-anchored onto Firebase Auth metadata.creationTime, which has no client write path. This stays open because createdAt remains forgeable for ANY OTHER consumer that reads it and assumes it is trustworthy. Fix pattern already exists in this same file at firestore.rules:1559 for a different collection: request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time. Nancy's view, which I share: separate task, but track it, do not drop it - this session is the only place that context currently exists.
